article.headline: Dye scores 22, Abilene Christian knocks off South Dakota State 101-95
article.description: — Isaac Dye had 22 points in Abilene Christian’s 101-95 victory against South Dakota State on Wednesday.

keywords: Abilene Christian Wildcats @ South Dakota State Jackrabbits
article.story: BROOKINGS, S.D. -- — Isaac Dye had 22 points in Abilene Christian’s 101-95 victory against South Dakota State on Wednesday. Dye shot 7 for 13 (5 for 10 from 3-point range) and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line for the Wildcats (4-3). Yaniel Rivera added 16 points while shooting 4 for 5 (3 for 4 from 3-point range) and 5 of 6 from the free-throw line while they also had five assists. Xabi Lopez had 13 points and finished 5 of 9 from the field. Joe Sayler finished with 27 points and two steals for the Jackrabbits (5-2). South Dakota State also got 20 points and eight rebounds from Davis Kern. Jon Mekonnen also had 18 points and seven rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
